tier1.text: The piriformis turns the thigh outward at the hip. This turn, called lateral rotation, moves the front of the thigh away from the body's midline. The piriformis shares this job with several other hip muscles. Each piriformis lies deeper than the gluteus maximus, the largest buttock muscle.
